description: VidyaSarthi - personal AI team for students

scripts.build:vercel: npm run db:pg-sync && prisma generate --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma && next build
scripts.db:pg-sync: sed 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' prisma/schema.prisma > prisma/schema.postgres.prisma && mkdir -p prisma/postgres && sed 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' prisma/schema.prisma > prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.db:pg-deploy: npm run db:pg-sync && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/postgres/schema.prisma
scripts.db:postgres: docker compose up -d db redis && env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://backoff:backoff@localhost:5432/backoff npm run db:pg-deploy
